facts.text: Buda began as Du Pre in 1881, but postal officials renamed it Buda in 1887 after discovering another Texas town shared the name.
The town sprang up along the International‑Great Northern Railroad, which extended from Austin to San Antonio in 1880, making the depot the town’s lifeblood.
In 1998 the Stanzel Brothers Trust transferred a 51‑acre parcel to Buda, creating Historic Stagecoach Park that blends outdoor recreation with local history.
Antioch Colony, founded in 1859, was a post‑Civil War settlement of freed African American families seeking land and independence.
Early Buda supported a hotel, mill, cheese factory, movie theatre, and skating rink, and its Chamber of Commerce was organized in 1928.
